permission.note: Public Google Calendar feed. Google documents this address for other apps to subscribe, so robots.txt does not apply to it (decision P40).

reviewNotes: Switched on 2026-10-05 after the owner shared the calendar. Read as a class calendar (defaults.category class-lesson). Skipped: Town of Hempstead residents-only classes (Levittown Hall, Echo Park, Merrick Golf Course) and Great Neck Community Education courses (30 Cumberland Ave), which need pre-registration and are not open drop-in; cardio/fitness sessions; the Wednesday practice social (Great Neck Ballroom lists its own); and the Brumidi Lodge dances (the lodge has its own source). Queens (Little Neck) listings are out of area.
